field-inventory-reviewed.summary: All 2,202 public records were included in a machine-checked field inventory. Every record carries the required identity, source, observation, derivation, evidence, access, rights, licence and authentication fields.

independent-rights-review.summary: A read-only AI-agent reviewer who did not author the acquisition, normalisation, build or release-evidence implementation reviewed the exact frozen candidate. This is independent agent review, not independent human legal or licence assurance.

prohibited-content-absent.summary: Full-candidate structural tests and targeted pattern scans found no raw page bodies, production property records, user submissions, private-key markers, GitHub tokens, AWS access keys, signed-download query parameters or email addresses in the public bundle.

rights-access-complete.summary: All 2,202 unique public record IDs have exactly one matching rights projection, explicit access and rights states, and a rights_ref resolving to a declared assessment. No missing, extra or mismatched rights rows were found.

limitations: This evidence supports a metadata-only AI-generated proof of concept and is not legal advice, licence advice, ownership evidence, priority evidence or exact-boundary advice.
No independent human legal, licence, privacy or accessibility audit was completed.
Pattern scans and structural validation reduce, but cannot prove the universal absence of every possible secret or personal-data form.
Live publisher terms and rights pages are locator-based evidence and were not archived as page bodies; later releases must revalidate them.
Dataset and repository rights remain source-specific and volatile. This review does not authorise redistribution of linked datasets, repository source trees, service results or restricted content.

residual_risks.disposition: accepted-gap; retain in the exact G9 release record and prominently disclose on the public site
residual_risks.summary: The release is AI-generated and independently AI-agent reviewed; no independent human legal, licence or accessibility audit was completed.
